# Orbit Lit conversation element

Source: https://github.com/kouryu339/orbit-runtime/tree/a9b235e82136a34478e4dcfd3c11b75990fd35e7/ui/lit

Verified against upstream main on 2026-10-13. Package version remains 0.1.0 upstream.
This directory vendors the runtime package manifest, license and compiled dist only.
Upstream development scripts/dependencies are omitted: its source/test toolchain is not needed to consume the compiled component.
Reidom pins the Lit dependency to 3.3.3 through npm overrides.
